tool_input.command:
git -C <repo> commit -q -m "fix(mission): refuse free-text values YAML truncated at an unquoted '#'

YAML opens a comment at a '#' that follows whitespace, so

    - name: PR #515 merged, 6/6 checks green

parses as the two-character name \"PR\" and discards the rest. Every
validator passed it because \"PR\" is non-empty, so on PR #516 a result
asserting a merge, a CI count, and a review-thread count was written
to results.yaml and round-tripped through 'ethos mission close' with
status: pass, describing nothing.

Detection is exact rather than a length heuristic: yaml.v3 hands back
the text it discarded as the node's LineComment, so a truncated scalar
is precisely one that is plain and carries a line comment. A minimum
length would have done neither half of the job — it rejects 'make
check' and admits a long value cut at its 40th character.

Fixes the class, not the instance. Every submitted-artifact schema has
free-text scalars with the same exposure, so the check runs on all
four: results (evidence names, open_questions, single-line prose),
reflections (reason, signals), corrections (claim, corrected, evidence
names), and contracts (success_criteria, context, delegation
messages). A correction is the costliest of the four — the artifact
retracting a false claim about a PR would itself be cut at that PR's
number.

Results, reflections, and corrections fold the check into their strict
decoder, since nothing but a submitted file reaches those. Contracts
cannot: DecodeContractStrict also reads contracts back off disk, where
the bytes are ethos's own marshal output, so the contract check runs
at the three entry points a human's file arrives through instead —
create (CLI and MCP) and lint.

Nothing that kept its text is flagged: a quoted value, a prose block
(where '#' is literal), a '#' with no leading space (ethos-56a#2), and
a comment on its own line all still pass, as do the trailing comments
on the enum, pattern, numeric, and path fields that ethos's own
scaffolds ship.

Confirmed red before green: the exact PR #516 evidence line was
accepted pre-fix, parsed as \"PR\" (.tmp/hashtrunc-prefix.log). Post-fix
the real binary refuses it:

  ethos: mission result: invalid result pr516-result.yaml:
  evidence[0].name: value truncated at an unquoted '#': YAML kept \"PR\"
  from line 7 (- name: PR #515 merged as 6f61406 — 6/6 CI checks
  green, 17 review threads resolved); quote the value, or move the
  comment to its own line

The --help examples for result, reflect, correct, and create now quote
their free-text values, since the unquoted ones invited this for any
name citing a bead ID or PR number."
